Adaptation of the best seller of the same name by John Grisham, directed by Joel Schumacher (''A Day of Fury'', ''Batman Forever''). Its plot starting point is vaguely reminiscent of that of ''Sole Witness'', although the Mormon community that surrounded Harrison Ford in Peter Weir's film is replaced here by a single character: that of a devoted lawyer. For this reason, the true core of the film, despite being a thriller, is not the judicial plot, but the relationship established between the boy, played by Brad Renfro (chosen from 5,000 candidates), and his lawyer, a role entrusted to Susan Sarandon, for which she was nominated for an Oscar for best actress. Tommy Lee Jones gave life to the third party, in the shoes of an ambitious prosecutor.

programme.title: The general's daughter
programme.desc: Officer Paul Brenner was investigating a dark case of corruption in the United States Army when Captain Elizabeth Campbell, daughter of the legendary General Joe Campbell, is violently murdered under strange conditions. His magnificent record and the excellent professional relationships that united him with the rest of the troops immediately direct the investigation towards a personal motive as the motive for the crime, something that, in Elizabeth's case, makes the authorities of the army's criminal investigation division fear the worst.

programme.title: The wanted
programme.desc: Henry Fonda is a priest persecuted by the authorities after the government has banned religion. His decision is to flee to another country, but at the border he will have difficulty getting out and will have to disguise himself. The film, directed by John Ford, is based on a novel by Graham Greene.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.: Harrelson's Men
programme.desc: Jim Street, former member of the S.W.A.T, was expelled from the team along with his partner Brian Gamble, due to a controversial decision he made in a robbery with hostages case. For Street, his work is his life and he is looking for the opportunity to wear the uniform again. That opportunity comes when Dan "Hondo" Harrelson, commander of the team, must recruit and train five high-level police officers for a new special weapons and tactics team. After a few hard weeks of training, the team goes into action: a drug lord offers a large sum of money to whoever frees him from police control. The S.W.A.T. team He must guard the enemy while being chased by a band of mercenaries. Film version of the famous 70's television series "Harrelson's Men".

programme.title: Hitman
programme.desc: Agent 47 has been genetically engineered to become an effective and lethal hitman, working under instructions from a mysterious group known as 'The Organization'. However, when he finds himself involved in a political conspiracy that is beyond his understanding, he will turn against what he has known until now to try to find out who has set him up. While Interpol and the Russian army search for him throughout Europe, the murderer will have to face two new elements in his life: conscience and love.

programme.title: Hitman. Agent 47
programme.desc: Based on the famous video game, Hitman is an elite assassin who has been genetically modified to become a perfect killing machine. Identified only by a barcode that he has tattooed, his target is a corporation that aims to reveal his past and create assassins more powerful than him.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Bruce Banner is a renowned scientist, with a murky family past, who suffers with his team a serious laboratory accident in which everyone is exposed to intense gamma radiation. When he discovers that he is the only one who has survived, he is confused and begins to investigate. But Bruce has developed a terrible ability after the accident that could hinder the investigation; when he gets angry he turns into a giant green monster with irrational and destructive behavior. To create the Hulk character using digital technology, the company Light & Magic made the largest technical deployment in its history. It was necessary to work together with one hundred and eighty ILM technicians and work on the character for more than a year and a half. Even so, there are viewers who have compared the technical quality of the Hulk to that of Shrek. In this film, Hulk reaches the largest size he had reached to date, nine meters tall. Ang Lee used the split-screen technique to cinematically imitate the panels of a comic book page. To do this, he had to shoot the same scene several times, which somewhat exhausted actor Eric Bana, who plays Brece Banner. Much of the microbiology work seen on screen is real, done by Ang Lee's wife.

programme.title: Karate kid, the moment of truth
programme.desc: Young Daniel La Russo arrives in Los Angeles from the North American east coast and suddenly finds himself faced with the difficult task of making new friends. He soon becomes the object of all kinds of ridicule from the Cobras, a rather violent group of karate students. Fortunately, at the same time he begins a relationship of friendship and love with Ali, the former girlfriend of the leader of the Cobras. Eager to face his enemies and at the same time impress his new friend, Daniel asks Master Miyagi, a true martial arts expert, to teach him how to fight. He agrees and teaches Daniel all the secrets to control the body and mind. In this way he will be able to face the Cobras in the Regional Karate Championships with a minimum of chances of victory. Little by little, and advised by Miyagi's experience, Daniel develops not only his physical strength, but also the faith in himself and the confidence necessary to face the most important combat of his life. As expected, Daniel will reach the final and will face none other than the leader of the Cobras. Despite being injured in a leg, Daniel will use one of the most risky kicks to win the fight and become the new regional karate champion. This is the seventh film of the protagonist, Ralph Macchio, and marked his true launch in the cinema. After this two other films in the saga would come out, and two other versions starting in 2000, but which did not star Macchio. Pat Morita, who plays Miyagi, was best known for his role in 'Karate Kid', but he was a prolific actor with more than 160 films as an actor in his career.

programme.desc: Remake of the film 'They Call Him Bodhi', directed in 1991 by Kathryn Bigelow ('The Darkest Night'). Johnny, a young FBI agent, infiltrates a team of elite athletes led by Boshi. However, when he begins to form a friendship with the leader, Johnny will question whose side he is on and what he should do.

programme.title: The flight
programme.desc: Commander Whip Whitaker is forced to make an emergency landing of the aircraft he is piloting, thereby saving many lives. He is considered a hero, until the subsequent investigation reveals that he had used narcotics the night before the incident. The pilot faces a trial in which he must put his career and his own life in order.

programme.title: A crime has been cooked: A Deadly Recipe
programme.desc: A sheriff turns up dead with a cupcake in his hand and Hannah's brother-in-law is the main suspect. To save him, the baker sets out to solve a crime full of secrets in Lake Eden.

programme.title: Darrow and Darrow: The Body of the Crime
programme.desc: Claire and Miles believe a convicted murderer is innocent and, a year after her imprisonment, begin investigating the case again.

programme.title: Morning Glory
programme.desc: Becky Fuller, an energetic TV producer, is fired from her job, her professional life becomes as bleak as her love life. To move forward with his career, he must face a new challenge: launching a morning magazine show on a New York channel.

programme.title: what a couple of cops
programme.desc: Two police officers are looking for a very expensive baseball card from 1952. They must rescue a Mexican supermodel and put an end to a drug organization.

programme.title: survive tonight
programme.desc: The home of a disgraced doctor is invaded by two criminals. One of them was shot during a robbery. Although the doctor tries to help him, his knowledge is insufficient to stop the bleeding. His only concern is to protect his family at all costs.

programme.title: The seductresses
programme.desc: Max and Page, mother and daughter, are two attractive con artists who use their charms to deceive and defraud naive millionaires. But on one of her assignments, Page meets a young man with whom she falls in love, which will make her change her attitude and question her old tricks. In addition, Max's ex-husband furiously pursues them very closely.

programme.title: Crank: High voltage
programme.desc: Hitman Chelios faces off against a Chinese gangster who has stolen his virtually indestructible heart and replaced it with a sophisticated battery-powered device that requires frequent bursts of electricity to continue functioning.

programme.title: The silence of the lambs
programme.desc: Promising FBI agent Clarice Starling is pulled from her special forces training by Jack Crawford of the FBI's Behavioral Study Unit. He wants me to study a notorious and eccentric psychopath named Habbibal Lecter, who was a forensic psychiatrist imprisoned for multiple murders and cannibalism. The purpose of the meetings between Clarice and Hannibal must be for the latter to agree to help her catch a serial killer named Buffalo Bill. But what the woman did not imagine was that Hannibal would turn out to be a sophisticated and cultured man restricted from others by glass walls. Although he is polite at first, he soon begins to lose patience when Clarice tries to create a psychological profile for him. While the hunts continue throughout Chicago and Buffalo Bill collects his kills without the FBI being able to do anything to solve it, Clarice will have to find a way to ingratiate herself with a man who ate the people around him and show him that, in addition to being intelligent, she is not afraid of him at all. Things will start to get difficult when the Senator's daughter disappears and everything indicates that Buffalo Bill has her and that soon her body will appear as a new victim. The events of this film take place after what happened in the film Hunter (1986). Although there are many characters in common in the two films, only two of the actors share films. Frankie Faison plays Lt. Fisk in Hunter and Barney in The Silence of the Lambs; On the other hand, Dan Butler plays the fingerprint expert FBI agent in Hunter and an entomologist in "The Silence of the Lambs."

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: 1945. James Francis Ryan's three brothers have died in combat within a few days of each other. The United States War Department orders that the last Ryan must be found and sent home immediately in compliance with the US military's sole survivor policy. Captain John Miller will be in charge of finding James. After German artillery kills members of his battalion during the Normandy landings, Miller assembles a group of seven men to help him accomplish his mission. The only thing he knows about Ryan's whereabouts is that he disappeared behind enemy lines after parachuting in with his squad. The team will risk their lives and travel across France in search of the soldier. During their journey they will have to fight to survive ambushes, snipers, lies and a bloody and cruel battle. The film, directed by Steven Spielberg, was a resounding success with critics. He received five Oscars, including best director, and two Golden Globes. It also took the box office by storm, grossing more than $480 million, making it the second highest-grossing film of 1998.

programme.title: The Kaiser's Last Kiss
programme.desc: A German officer must determine whether the British Secret Service has infiltrated the home of Kaiser Wilhelm II, but begins a dangerous romance with a young Dutch Jew.

programme.title: Llamaradas
programme.desc: He was a child when he witnessed the death of his father in an act of service during a fire. Twenty years later, Brian is also a firefighter in Chicago. He is in a difficult trial period led by his brother Stephen who is very demanding of him. Both brothers will try to overcome disputes and memories of the past while an arsonist sets fires in the city.

programme.title: Pelham Train Assault 123
programme.desc: A criminal and his gang take over a subway car, threatening to kill the passengers one by one if they are not paid what is demanded. However, a subway worker who knows the tunnel system very well will make things quite difficult for you.

programme.title: natural born killers
programme.desc: Mickey and Mallory are two young people who, in love and maddened, murder the girl's father in cold blood and begin a flight. The host of a sensational program decides to take advantage of the fascination that his personality exerts on the public to turn the murderers into television heroes.

programme.title: The flight
programme.desc: Commander Whip Whitaker is forced to make an emergency landing of the aircraft he is piloting, thereby saving many lives. He is considered a hero, until the subsequent investigation reveals that he had used narcotics the night before the incident. The pilot faces a trial in which he must put his career and his own life in order.

programme.title: Haute couture
programme.desc: Esther, seamstress at the House of Dior, works on her latest Haute Couture collection, before retiring. Jade, a 20-year-old girl, steals her purse.

programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: Filmed entirely in the Philippines, "Platoon" tells us about the year a young university student named Chris spends in a regiment, who decides to volunteer for the Vietnam War. First part of a trilogy directed and written by Oliver Stone about the Vietnam War (followed by Born on the Fourth of July and Between Heaven and Earth). The protagonist of this story is a young Charlie Sheen, accompanied by a cast among which we highlight Willem Dafoe, Tom Berenger or some at that time still unknown Forest Whitaker or Johnny Depp. "Platoon" was the first film about Vietnam written and directed by a veteran of that war. Oliver Stone created this masterpiece taken from the experiences that he himself lived on the battlefield in his year as a soldier, filming almost a documentary where he tells us in first person through a character named Chris all his experiences in Vietnam. We are thus witnessing one of the most precise and realistic war films that recount this conflict with excellent direction, a script and impeccable editing. As for the exteriors, they are very well detailed and this perfection makes the viewer quickly immerse themselves in the war atmosphere that surrounds everything without rest. Definitely, a spectacular film that shows what until then Hollywood always tried to hide and the best way to get closer to what those days in Vietnam really were. Classic of the eighties and universal cinema.

programme.title: Dangerous instinct
programme.desc: A retired hitman is headed to his brother's funeral on a remote island when a group of mercenaries burst in looking for the money his brother owes them. With the support of Dr. Oberfeld, FBI agent Shaughnessy and the local sheriff, a tireless search for revenge will begin.

programme.title: Night of Vengeance
programme.desc: Vincent is a divorced man with a teenage son, Thomas, with whom he barely has a relationship. He works as a police officer in Los Angeles, dealing with corrupt matters hidden from Internal Affairs. After a heist in which he steals a shipment of cocaine from a dealer in Las Vegas, Vincent and his partner Sean Cass volunteer to investigate the case in order to hide their guilt and involvement from Internal Affairs. One afternoon when Vincent is walking with his son, the group of criminals from whom he stole cocaine corners him and kidnaps Thomas, threatening to end his life if he does not return the drugs. The leaders of Internal Affairs suspect Vincent and decide to investigate him. He only has one night to recover his son safe and sound, return the drug shipment, hide the truth from his ex-partner and cleanse his image in front of the heads of Internal Affairs.

programme.title: Life at stake
programme.desc: The film delves into the story of Sean Porter, Camp Kilpatrick juvenile detention camp probation officer and retired player, and his partner, Officer Malcolm Moore, who turned a group of dangerous juvenile delinquents into the Camp Kilpatrick Mustangs football team, having a fantastic season in 1990 and reaching the regional championship final against the Montclair Prep High School team. Porter will teach the boys to go against gang rivalries and bitter hatreds between peers, and both he and the young men will learn difficult lessons about life while the boys also acquire a sense of responsibility and self-respect.

programme.title: 10 minutes less
programme.desc: During a failed bank robbery, Frank is hit in the head and loses his memory. He'll need to piece together the missing 10 minutes of his mind if he wants to find the person responsible for his fall from grace.

programme.title: Contraband
programme.desc: Chris, a legendary smuggler, decided long ago to leave the world of crime. Now he will be forced to resume his activity to pay the debt of Andy, his brother-in-law, when he makes a mistake in a drug deal.

programme.title: 22 Balas
programme.desc: A former gangster who has been retired for years is attacked and left for dead after receiving 22 bullets, but after miraculously surviving, he begins his revenge.

programme.title: Talking Business
programme.desc: Is the space economy the next gold rush? Elon Musk's SpaceX has sparked the public's imagination after its recent stock market debut, but what will all the money being thrown into the space industry actually achieve? The founder of leading investment firm Space Capital, Chad Anderson, explains how what happens in orbit is increasingly important to the economy down on Earth. Ben Thompson also hears from the head of the UN's Office for Outer Space Affairs, Aarti Holla-Maini, about how space law is keeping up with an industry that is moving at breakneck speed. Also on the programme, the billionaire founder of New Zealand-based Rocket Lab, Sir Peter Beck, shines a light on what the private sector can achieve in space and whether SpaceX are friends or rivals.

programme.title: The Climate Question
programme.desc: A global programme that reflects the variety of takes on climate change, how best to understand it and the world's attempts to avert it, temper it or adapt to it. It is not about questioning whether climate change is happening, it's about finding the best ways to respond to it. This is sharp-edged, analytical inquiry. Hard scrutiny, touched with a sense of adventure and discovery, and where we can find it, hope. It includes stories from across the world on why we find it so hard to save our own planet, and how we might change that.

programme.title: Kesengsem Tukang Sedot WC
programme.desc: Dika, seorang tukang sedot WC yang tampan, yang terlibat masalah dengan atasan barunya, anak perempuan pemilik perusahaan yang ditugaskan untuk menyelidiki dugaan penyelewengan dana perusahaan.

programme.title: Jubah Tak Kasat Mata
programme.desc: Sinta, gadis cantik dan ambisius dari keluarga kurang mampu. Setelah menemukan Jubah Tak Kasat Mata di toko Kr. Amat, dia menyusup masuk ke rumah Poppy dan mencuri uang dari brankas. Tapi ternyata jubah tersebut membawa kutukan.

programme.title: Harta Karun Nenek Bajak
programme.desc: Putri mempunyai kekasih yang terlibat hutang bernama Draco. Saat sedang terdesak dia teringat bahwa dia memiliki kenalan bernama Mira yang memiliki nenek kaya raya bernama Nenek Bajak di kampungnya. Putri menipu Nenek Bajak.

programme.title: Gara Gara Kitab
programme.desc: Jack, seorang pencuri yang sedang buron. Suatu ketika ia merampok sebuah rumah dan mengambil satu peti mewah. Ia mengira itu adalah peti yang memuat perhiasan serta uang banyak, namun ternyata isinya benar-benar di luar dugaan.

programme.title: Pembalap Insyaf
programme.desc: Vivi harus menghidupi keluarganya dengan bekerja sebagai pembalap liar untuk Angga. Sementara Bayu adalah seorang polisi. Ketika balapan liar digerebek secara tiba-tiba. Vivi melarikan diri dan pingsan di sebuah musala.

programme.title: Terperangkap Di Alas Roban
programme.desc: Saat pulang dari liburan, bus yang ditumpangi Muham dan temannya mogok tepat di tengah wilayah angker. Mereka menolong seorang gadis yang ternyata disandera makhluk misterius di sana.

programme.title: Kembali Ke Sekolah
programme.desc: Kisah seorang pemuda manja dan kekanak-kanakan yang tidak mengenyam pendidikan. Setelah ayahnya meninggal, dia mewarisi semua harta peninggalannya, namun syaratnya dia harus memiliki ijazah terlebih dulu.

programme.title: Kesengsem Tukang Sedot WC
programme.desc: Dika, seorang tukang sedot WC yang tampan, yang terlibat masalah dengan atasan barunya, anak perempuan pemilik perusahaan yang ditugaskan untuk menyelidiki dugaan penyelewengan dana perusahaan.

programme.title: Married Failed
programme.desc: Raline bersama Rega, pacarnya, berencana untuk menikah. Segala persiapan pernikahan sudah dirancang Raline. Tiba-tiba Rega bertemu dengan Nesha, mantan pacarnya, dan masih saling menyukai.

programme.title: The Power Of Emak-Emak
programme.desc: Ibu Elis mengkhawatirkan Ira, anaknya yang pacaran dengan Andra. Ira tidak menyadari Andra itu playboy. Ibu Elis tidak setuju Ira melanjutkan hubungannya dengan Andra karena Andra sudah dua kali menabrak Ibu Elis.

programme.title: Cinta Lutung Kasarung
programme.desc: Rara yang culas dan ambisius kecewa ketika Sari terpilih sebagai pewaris utama Prabu. Rara bersekongkol dengan Indra tunangannya untuk menyingkirkan Sari dengan memberinya ramuan yang membuat kulitnya bersisik

programme.title: Mirror World
programme.desc: Vuri adalah siswi SMA yang menjadi bahan olok-olok dan ketinggalan dalam pelajaran sekolah. Hingga dia menemukan sebuah cermin yang membawanya ke dunia lain yang keadaannya berbeda 180 derajat dengan dunianya sekarang.

programme.title: 7 Pusaka - Sabuk Penghilang Raga
programme.desc: Raga adalah seorang maling kelas teri yang bernasib sial. Saat dikejar para warga dan bersembunyi di dalam sebuah kali, tiba-tiba Raga menemukan sebuah koin gobang yang hanyut. Saat Raga menggenggam koin itu, ia menghilang.

programme.title: Mantan Yang Tak Diundang
programme.desc: Ketika sedang berjalan dengan pacarnya, Kiena bertemu David, mantan pacarnya dulu. Yosha, pacar Kiena merasa kesal David yang sering mengajak Kiena jalan. Apakah Kiena tetap setia dengan Yosha? Atau kembali dengan mantannya?

programme.title: 7 Hari Kemudian
programme.desc: Mike, cowok playboy sekolah terkenal suka mempermainkan cewek. Fika mantan pacar Mike meninggal dunia karena bunuh diri. Amanda dan teman-temannya berencana membuat jera Mike. Mereka mengatur strategi untuk menjebak Mike.

programme.title: Toko Kr.Amat Sepeda Onthel Badai
programme.desc: Guntur berencana membeli sepeda ontel di toko Kr.Amat yang katanya bisa melaju secepat cahaya hanya dengan sekali kayuh. Terbukti ketika Guntur mengayuh pedal tiba-tiba sepeda itu melesat sangat kencang lalu lenyap dalam sekejap.

programme.title: Manusia Ikan Jatuh Cinta
programme.desc: Karena ayahnya bangkrut, Risa terpaksa pindah ke sebuah kampung dekat laut. Di sana, saat dia nyaris tenggelam, tiba-tiba ada yang membawanya ke permukaan. Saat tersadar, dia hanya melihat sekilas manusia dengan sirip ikan.

programme.title: Manusia Ikan Jatuh Cinta
programme.desc: Karena ayahnya bangkrut, Risa terpaksa pindah ke sebuah kampung dekat laut. Di sana, saat dia nyaris tenggelam, tiba-tiba ada yang membawanya ke permukaan. Saat tersadar, dia hanya melihat sekilas manusia dengan sirip ikan.

programme.title: Disciples Of The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: Sutradara film bela diri nan legendaris, Lau Kar-leung, menuai pujian saat menyutradarai film yang menampilkan Gordon Liu sebagai San Te si biksu berjubah emas seperti dalam film The 36th Chamber Of Shaolin.

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Dua polisi dengan sifat berbeda ditugaskan untuk menangkap seorang bos narkoba. Yang satu melakukan segalanya sesuai hukum dan yang satunya melakukan apa pun demi menuntaskan kejahatan.

programme.title: The Emperor And His Brother
programme.desc: Kaisar Qianlong bukanlah penerus takhta yang sah saat lahir, tapi ia baru mengetahui kebenarannya saat dua anggota senior dari organisasi subversif rahasia anti-pemerintah menghubunginya beberapa tahun kemudian.

programme.title: Call Of The Sea
programme.desc: Seorang nelayan muda bernama Chin Hu jatuh cinta dengan teman masa kecilnya, Hsiao Yu. Namun, putra satu-satunya preman di sana terpukau pada kecantikan Hsiao Yu dan mencoba segala cara untuk mendekatinya.

programme.title: Holy Flame Of The Martial World
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah populer tentang kakak beradik yang menggunakan teknik kung fu Api Suci yin/yang untuk membalaskan dendam atas kematian orangtua mereka.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: Sebuah opera menarik yang menceritakan tentang Fei E, putri seorang Jenderal yang menyamar sebagai seorang anak laki-laki dan menipu semua orang, termasuk dua sahabatnya di sekolah.

programme.title: The Spirit Of The Sword
programme.desc: Ketua Klan Air terluka parah oleh seorang samurai pembunuh sesaat sebelum duel tahunan di Danau Taihu. Ia menugaskan saudaranya Bao Yu dalam perjalanan panjang untuk menemukan obat untuknya.

programme.title: The Adv. Of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Liu Yung berperan sebagai detektif di masa Dinasti Ching yang menyelidiki kasus korupsi di pengadilan dengan bantuan seorang pemuda cerdik. Mereka memberikan pelajaran berharga pada orang-orang korup ini.

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Seorang penderita skizofrenia menolak mempercayai jika kekasihnya yang seorang pilot telah meninggal. Ia percaya jika kematian sang kekasih hanyalah kebohongan yang diciptakan untuk mengakhiri hubungan mereka.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang adalah seorang gadis yang tidak takut untuk melawan para preman. Sayangnya, ia mengira Ma Ta-hai yang tampan sebagai salah satu preman itu. Keduanya saling tertarik, namun mereka menolak untuk mengakuinya.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: Selama lima tahun, Alex menjalani pernikahan bahagia dengan istrinya Tung, seorang ginekolog. Saat Alex terluka parah dalam sebuah kecelakaan, ia merasa harus memberitahu Tung tentang perselingkuhannya dengan Blackie.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Kisah cinta antara sesosok peri nan memikat yang turun dari surga untuk menjalani kehidupan di Hong Kong pada tahun 70-an dengan seorang pria yang mengelola sebuah panti asuhan yang terlilit hutang.

programme.title: Return Of One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Pendekar Pedang Bertangan Satu dipaksa keluar dari masa pensiunnya oleh sebuah organisasi kriminal yang terdiri dari delapan pendekar pedang, yang telah memaksa setiap klan untuk mengirimkan pendekar pedang terbaik mereka untuk bersaing melawan mereka demi supremasi pendekar pedang.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong Rhapsody adalah film musikal yang penuh dengan lagu dan tarian. Peter Chen-Ho berperan sebagai pesulap playboy yang mengubah cara hidupnya setelah menjadi penjaga seorang penyanyi muda.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: Seorang ahli kung fu dan tiga muridnya kehilangan segalanya usai dikalahkan oleh seorang penindas. Demi membalas dendam, ketiga murid tersebut berlatih pada master kung fu lainnya dan kembali menghadapi si penindas.

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun tak mau menyuap seorang pelukis kekaisaran sehingga si pelukis menggambar potret jelek dirinya, yang membuatnya tak dipilih oleh Kaisar sampai mereka bertemu langsung.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Komedi yang menggelikan ini menampilkan seorang pria lugu bernama Ah Niu. Dia pergi ke Hong Kong dan terus-menerus dieksploitasi dan dimanfaatkan, bahkan ditangkap dan dipenjara.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei berperan sebagai seorang penyanyi muda bernama Hsiao-Yun yang bimbang antara kesuksesannya dalam karier dan hubungannya dengan sang kekasih, seorang pianis bernama Li Yen-nan.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu dan rekannya tengah melakukan sebuah misi untuk menghancurkan 'Phoenix Lute', sebuah senjata mematikan yang dapat menembakkan jarum-jarum beracun dan hanya dapat dihancurkan oleh pedang lengkung Kan.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: Seorang sineas, Li han-hsiang, mengubah kisah-kisah erotis dan mistis dari kesusasteraan Tiongkok klasik dan mengubahnya menjadi sebuah film yang luar biasa.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: Saat ayahnya dibunuh dengan kejam pada awal era republik Tiongkok, seorang gadis muda memiliki sebuah daftar penjahat yang telah berkomplot melawan ayahnya dan memulai perjalanan untuk memburu sang pembunuh berantai.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli kung fu gaya monyet yang dikalahkan oleh seorang penjahat kejam diyakinkan oleh murid mudanya untuk mengajarinya kung fu gaya monyet demi membalas rasa malunya.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Kueh Chih Hung, sang sutradara pujaan, menampilkan kisah tragedi romantis tentang arwah Lo Meng yang berupaya merasuk ke dalam tubuh cinta sejatinya, namun upayanya justru menjadi bumerang.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Pasangan muda dan anak mereka hidup di pulau Aleusia yang terisolasi dari dunia luar. Seperti penduduk asli Aleusia yang lain, sang ayah telah lama memburu anjing laut emas yang selama ini dianggap sebagai mitos semata.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao pernah dikalahkan oleh Long dalam suatu duel. Tujuh tahun kemudian, Long meminta Zhao membuat sebuah lentera unik atas namanya untuk memenangkan kontes lentera. Zhao pun berencana untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Seorang anak dari keluarga kaya yang gemar bermain gitar bernama Yang Fan pergi ke Jepang untuk bergabung dengan sebuah band rock. Ia juga berusaha mendapatkan cinta dari dua gadis cantik.

programme.title: Return To The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: Dalam bagian ke-dua dari trilogi ini, Gordon Liu berperan sebagai Zhou Ren Jie yang menyamar sebagai biksu untuk belajar kung fu di Shaolin, dan akhirnya menciptakan gaya kungfunya sendiri.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai memerkosa Qiu Rong dan berjanji akan menikahinya usai mendapat persetujuan orang tuanya. Namun, tak ada kabar lagi tentang pernikahan tersebut. Qiu pun mendesak Liang Cai saat menyadari bahwa dirinya hamil.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu berupaya hidup terhormat dan mengabdi sebagai seorang anggota triad yang setia. Namun seiring berjalannya waktu, niat baik Liu membawanya ke dalam perang antargeng tanpa henti dengan dampak yang mengerikan.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Kisah ini terjadi di sebuah apartemen kuno yang dihuni oleh berbagai karakter. Seorang pengembang properti berupaya memiliki apartemen itu untuk dibangun kembali.

programme.title: The Flag Of Iron
programme.desc: Bendera Besi adalah sebuah klan berbudi pekerti luhur yang harus berhadapan dengan Perhimpunan Rajawali yang menjadi pelindung kegiatan-kegiatan ilegal.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Beberapa bintang wanita terbesar Shaw Brothers di tahun 1970-an tampil bersama dalam kisah tentang cinta dan orangtua yang terlampau ikut campur. Dibintangi oleh Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei dan Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua adalah pendekar pedang wanita nan jujur dan pemberani yang akan melawan penjahat dan melakukan apa pun demi Luo, pria yang ia cintai. Saat Luo dijebloskan ke penjara oleh polisi korup, ia berusaha membebaskannya.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: Seorang mantan pembalap ingin membuktikan kelihaiannya dalam sebuah balapan, tapi ia malah melukai rekan setimnya, Lily. Dapatkah tim mereka kembali berjaya kala seorang juara balap mobil virtual bergabung di tim?

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: Ketika Qing Cheng masih remaja, ia diserang oleh monster mutan yang tidak dikenal dan kehilangan keluarga serta ingatannya. Ia dianggap oleh penduduk desa sebagai orang yang tidak menyenangkan yang akan membawa bencana.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei mengalami gangguan pascatrauma usai kematian istrinya. Suatu hari, ia bertemu Amy yang bekerja di perusahaan teknologi VR dan diundang untuk menguji produk baru. Ia pun menjadi petarung VR perusahaan itu.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: Seorang penulis yang putus asa menjalin persahabatan yang tidak terduga dengan seorang remaja dari Long Island.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detektif Lin membentuk unit khusus untuk menangkap perampok motor dan sindikat di balik aksi pencurian di Foshan usai istrinya yang hamil ditabrak oleh perampok motor.

programme.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
programme.desc: Kisah tentang pengalaman imigran ilegal dari Tiongkok daratan yang berhasil sampai ke Hong Kong untuk kehidupan yang lebih baik.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing dan kakaknya, Ma Tai Chueng, tiba di Shanghai untuk mencari peruntungan. Berteman dengan seorang gangster berkuasa, ia diberi klub malam sebagai imbalan atas penyelamatan nyawa Tam Sei. Sayangnya, seorang gangster lain juga menginginkan wilayah tersebut.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Seorang playboy kaya tewas akibat diledakkan oleh seorang gangster ketika ia menggoda istri gangster tersebut. Melalui serangkaian kejadian, profesornya membuatkan tubuh sintetis yang memungkinkannya untuk berubah menjadi apa pun yang diinginkannya.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: Seorang pria tunanetra, You Ji Ren, bekerja di sebuah pabrik di pulau terpencil. Karena badai, pabrik itu terisolasi dan muncul sesosok monster yang membuat siapa pun berubah menjadi bayangan hitam jika melihatnya.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: Raja Naga dikunci dalam segel oleh Tuan Naga selama 500 tahun, dan putri sang Raja harus kembali ke masa lalu guna membunuh Tuan Naga saat mengetahui bahwa keduanya adalah teman dekat di masa lalu.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi akan mewarisi kekayaan kakeknya yang tengah sekarat dengan satu syarat, yaitu ia harus menikah dalam waktu sebulan. Jika tidak, warisan tersebut akan diberikan kepada sang paman yang bernama Robert.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Tn. Zhang diusir dari klannya setelah tahanan Chi melarikan diri di bawah pengawasannya. Lalu, Tn. Zhang datang ke sebuah lokasi tempat hilangnya sejumlah orang dan menemukan bahwa Chi lah yang menangkap mereka.

programme.title: Kung Fu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini menyoroti para master Kung Fu Tiongkok yang terkenal di industri film, memamerkan warisan Kung Fu Hong Kong selama enam puluh tahun dan mengabadikan kehidupan mereka yang penuh tantangan.

programme.title: Kung Fu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Dokumenter ini menyoroti para master Kung Fu Tiongkok yang terkenal di industri film, memamerkan warisan Kung Fu Hong Kong selama enam puluh tahun dan mengabadikan kehidupan mereka yang penuh tantangan.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man menerima sebuah tantangan bertarung dari master asal utara yang sudah tua bernama Gong Yu Tian dan berhasil memenangkannya. Namun, ia dikalahkan oleh putri sang master, Gong Er, dan jatuh cinta padanya.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah menarik tentang kerumitan dalam menciptakan anak, yang menampilkan penampilan komedi langka oleh Alex Man Chi Leung.

programme.title: Behind The Yellow Line
programme.desc: Seorang pria muda yang pemalu dan pekerja kantoran, bertemu dengan seorang wanita cantik dan ambisius yang sedang mengejar karirnya, serta seorang pria lain yang ramah namun penuh rahasia. Pertemuan ini membawa mereka ke dalam perjalanan emosional yang kompleks, penuh dengan kebingungan, kesalahpahaman, dan penemuan diri.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Monyet Batu, memberikan harapan kepada seorang gadis kecil nan putus asa. Namun, Monyet Batu dikalahkan dalam pertempuran melawan Dewa Perang bermata tiga, yang membuatnya kehilangan kekuatan dan jatuh ke dunia fana.

programme.title: Women

But the guests are dodgy old Ray, Gav, Ricky, and - to Dennis's horror - crime boss Stan Grainger; the man Dennis helped send down. Inside, the men drink, bait each other with bar tricks and needle Dennis about his past. Stan demands a knife for the cake - a cake that reads 'Sorry You're Going Away'. But after a power cut, one of the party is found dead on the floor - the kitchen knife in his chest. Forced into detective mode to save his own skin, Dennis begins reconstructing the blackout second by second, probing contradictions in the guests' accounts while trying to work out whether the murder was spontaneous or meticulously planned. programme.desc: In 2001, Kathleen prepares for a Christmas to remember despite the family's ever-mounting financial woes. Years later, Sophie continues her quest to prove Michael's innocence after a body with similar injuries to Kathleen's arrives in the county morgue. Meanwhile, questions about the state's justice system surface that could turn the tides of the Peterson case, and Martha decides to dig into her fraught past, despite pushback from Margaret.

programme.title: Unwind with ITV
programme.desc: Your daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection. [S,HD]

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary begins his Irish food tour at Blackhead Lighthouse, taking in sweeping views across Belfast Lough before setting off along the iconic Causeway Coastal Route. In the Glens of Antrim he meets Declan, a sixth-generation farmer preserving traditional methods on his heritage farm. With no modern machinery in sight, Dermot gets stuck in handling Irish Gold, the humble potato. After working, the pair retreat to a storybook cottage to cook potato breads over an open fire, generously slathered with local butter. From rustic charm to stately grandeur, Dermot's journey through the glens continues to Glenarm Castle, home to the Earls of Antrim for over 400 years. Estate manager Adrian Morrow shares its rich history, before chef Paula McIntyre leads Dermot into the kitchen garden to gather fresh produce. Together, they fire up the smoker for some world-famous Glenarm beef, paired with a vibrant summer runner bean salad.

programme.title: WhatsApp Obsession: The Murder of Stephanie Hansen

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Crime drama series. DCI Vera Stanhope is called to the University of Northumberland when Jamie Marshall - a young and promising journalism student - plummets to his death from the top of a disused faculty building. With no eyewitnesses and no immediate leads, Vera turns to friends and family to glean all she can about Jamie and to discover who might have wanted him dead. Vera's investigation delves further into Jamie's academic and personal life as it becomes apparent that all is not as it seems. His sunny persona is betrayed by vlog posts that cast Jamie in a different light altogether; with anger and resentment bubbling to the surface, what was Jamie rallying against? In writing part-time for the local newspaper, could this bright and popular student have made enemies that would want to silence him? Facing deception from all quarters, Vera must unravel the tangled web of relationships in Jamie's life before an unexpected chain of events leads to disastrous consequences.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Marple
programme.desc: Miss Marple is shocked when her old friend Father Gorman is brutally murdered after visiting a dying parishioner. She is further surprised when she receives a letter from Gorman, sent moments before his death, which contains a list of names. When Detective Inspector Lejeune dismisses the list, Miss Marple is determined to seek justice for her friend herself. She finds another copy of the list at the parishioner's home, and a clue which leads her to The Pale Horse, an inn run by three modern-day witches who claim to be able to kill using black magic. While in the area, she attends a ritual 'burning' in memory of famous witch Goody Carne and meets locals including folklore historian Mark Easterbrook. Then a guest at The Pale Horse is found dead, and Miss Marple fears there may be worse to come. She must go to dangerous lengths to uncover the truth behind the mystery. Is magic really someone's weapon of choice or is there something even more sinister at work?

programme.title: Australian Drag Racing Championship 2024
programme.desc: The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top petrol dragsters that reach speeds of around 500 km/h in under 5 seconds (channel info).

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing professionals are carried out of the curve, then we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of sophisticated tin bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed. (Station info).

programme.title: Dumbest Stuff on Wheels
programme.desc: Bizarre mishaps, weird crashes and unbelievable nonsense on four wheels, fabricated in everyday life and immortalized on camera. Great workout for your laughing muscles! (Station info).

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: A few kilometers south of Bern, in the Swiss classic car gallery Toffen, 100 everyday oldies for little money, as well as valuable exotic cars, are going under the hammer: from the Fiat 500 C Belvedere with an estimated value of 13,000 euros to the Ford Mustang Shelby GT 500 KR Convertible for an estimated 140,000 euros. Classic Ride mingles with the international audience and accompanies an oldies seller and a bidder; One person hopes to make money, the other wants to buy beautiful metal for little money. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Top speed presenter Martin Utberg receives an invitation from the Morgan Sports Car Club Germany to the Racing Day in Zandvoort, the Netherlands. He once had his first racing experiences at the legendary race track and is now returning for Racing Day! A new exciting episode of Top Speed ​​Classics. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The "Stunt Heroes" show what can happen when a person flies into a car: it explodes and collapses completely! The action report shows what tricks and preparation are necessary, how a car is made "soft" and how to properly jump from a high-rise building. Fascinating insights into the world of film stunts! (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Crete is the largest of the Greek islands and a motorcycle paradise. Curves overlooking the sea, mountain passes up to 1200m and sensational panoramas, gorges and hospitable people. We started our day tours to experience Crete from the Robinson Club in Ierapetra. The documentary shows the most beautiful mountain roads and bays in the eastern part of the island. Our day tours led to the famous Dikti Mountains. This film also shows the Lasithi plateau, the famous Vai Beach and a tour to the former hippie village and the caves of Matala. The highlight is the ride up to the mountain village of Ethia on what is probably one of the most spectacular (station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: What is the correct name? The boat, the boat or the boat? Well, today, for once, it's the Boot, because we're making a little trip to Düsseldorf with Motorvision on Tour and that's where the Boot is taking place and that's the world's largest yacht and water sports trade fair in the entire world. (Station info).

programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Classic cars and everything that goes with them: events, racing, portraits, mechanic tips and the most beautiful pictures from the automobile archives from all over the world. The most beautiful oldies, the hottest racing cars from bygone eras. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave
programme.desc: Compact, efficient and environmentally friendly. Electric minis are redefining urban lifestyles. With the Rocks-e, Opel wants to revolutionize city traffic and help young people get their first car. The e.GO Life has space for four people and a range that should be sufficient for everyday life. We tested it! Also: An overview of the latest small electric cars. (Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: The traditional brands Jaguar and Land Rover are experiencing a huge upheaval under the umbrella of the Indian Tata Group. Jaguar is rejuvenating itself significantly, Land Rover is expanding with more and more new models. MOTORVISION TV shows how the tightrope walk between tradition and innovation is successful and what role the label “Made in England” plays in this. (Station info).

programme.title: Four-wheel drive adventure
programme.desc: 56. A new golf competitor is poaching in town. Nissan is attacking again. The Almera is dead, long live the Qashqai. What sells well in the upper classes can't be bad for the compacts. So the successor to the unsuccessful Almera comes with a trendy off-road look. (Station info).

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: With Perfect Ride the horsepower is thrown. Armin Schwarz's tires glow on ice and snow in Finland. Drift until the snow watch comes. Also: An extravagant duel at the CES in Vegas: Mercedes, the Warrior of the Stars versus Audi, Lord of the Rings. The latest technological wonders in direct comparison. (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: The all-wheel drive station wagon Volvo V40 Cross Country and the Mercedes Benz 4MATIC range with the flagship S 500, the mid-range sedan C 400 and the compact SUV GLA 250. All of these vehicles have one thing in common: They show how much fun you can have with all-wheel drive on ice and snow and in the bitter cold. (Station info).

programme.title: Tuning – it doesn’t get any lower than that!
programme.desc: Premium tuners and factory tuners: More and more horsepower, better and better sound, ever lower chassis, there are no limits. The finest tuning has to offer. Tips and tricks for lowering, repairing and pimping up. We show you what you can do and how to do it. The German Race Wars invite you to sprint over the quarter mile. Fast cars, smoking tires and full throttle at the starting lights (channel info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: On July 10, 2023, the legendary former racing driver and car designer Erich Bitter died. However, his dream was not lost with his death, as his nephew Markus Bitter continued his work at Bitter Cars. Top Speed ​​presenter Martin Utberg visits Markus and travels back in time with him and looks into the future of Bitter Cars. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The motorsport department of Bayerische Motorenwerke has been a success story since it was founded. And not just on the racetrack. The road cars with the letter M on the rear fascinate worldwide and quickly gained a large fan base. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: Compact high-performance models have a long-standing tradition at BMW. From the 2002 turbo to the 1 Series M Coupe to the current M2. We take a closer look at the second generation and test the drifting potential, racing and everyday qualities of the M2. What does he do best? We also look at its history and development and take a look at its competitors. (Station info).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: On July 10, 2023, the legendary former racing driver and car designer Erich Bitter died. However, his dream was not lost with his death, as his nephew Markus Bitter continued his work at Bitter Cars. Top Speed ​​presenter Martin Utberg visits Markus and travels back in time with him and looks into the future of Bitter Cars. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The motorsport department of Bayerische Motorenwerke has been a success story since it was founded. And not just on the racetrack. The road cars with the letter M on the rear fascinate worldwide and quickly gained a large fan base. (Station info).

programme.title: Super Cars
programme.desc: Compact high-performance models have a long-standing tradition at BMW. From the 2002 turbo to the 1 Series M Coupe to the current M2. We take a closer look at the second generation and test the drifting potential, racing and everyday qualities of the M2. What does he do best? We also look at its history and development and take a look at its competitors. (Station info).

programme.title: Australian Drag Racing Championship 2024
programme.desc: The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top petrol dragsters that reach speeds of around 500 km/h in under 5 seconds (channel info).

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing professionals are carried out of the curve, then we are there with the camera. programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: For the 16th time, Saxony's longest automobile museum is traveling through the country! Saxon picture-book scenery and picturesque routes in the middle of spectator trellises. programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The stuntheroes from Action Concept are tough professionals. They throw themselves off houses, cause cars to fly or explode. Without the necessary seriousness and constant concentration when carrying out your work, nothing works. We sent our reporter Dean Malay to Action Concept to get to know the people, the characters behind the hard shell. Stunt coordinator Domi shows Dean the work processes at Action Concept, but also explains why the stuntman is called Tobi, Heidi. (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Crete is the largest of the Greek islands and a motorcycle paradise. Curves overlooking the sea, mountain passes up to 1200m and sensational panoramas, gorges and hospitable people. We started our day tours to experience Crete from the Robinson Club in Ierapetra. The documentary shows the most beautiful mountain roads and bays in the eastern part of the island. Our day tours led to the famous Dikti Mountains. This film also shows the Lasithi plateau, the famous Vai Beach and a tour to the former hippie village and the caves of Matala. The highlight is the ride up to the mountain village of Ethia on what is probably one of the most spectacular (station info).

programme.title: Reportage
programme.sub-title: Isle of Man TT_ The toughest road race in the world
programme.desc: Road racing has been around for as long as motorcycle racing has existed. This form of circuit racing has always been the most dangerous, toughest and most demanding version of motorcycling. But what constitutes a street race? How do you equip people and machines for this particularly dangerous form of motorcycling? The incomparable highlight since 1907 has been the Tourist Trophy on the British island of the Isle of Man. The most famous motorcycle race in the world takes place every year on the just over 60 kilometer long Snaefall Mountain Course. And it's addictive. Once you've had a taste of the TT, you won't be able to stop it, says Klaus Klaff (channel information).

programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: In 2018, the Legends Winter Classic will move into its headquarters in Sonthofen for the first time and will send participants from six nations on a winter rally tour through five countries. There are only three days left to traverse the route from Oberjoch via stations such as the Lechtal, Alpine passes, the Dolomites and Tyrol. Top Speed ​​Classic is on site. (Station info).

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: This episode is all about motorcycle stunts: high jumps, hard falls and dangerous crashes! As always, stunt coordinator Domi demands everything from his motorcycle specialists Daniel and Marcel. They have a tough chase in the Action Concept yard... Crash report on two wheels. (Station info).

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Tenerife is not just a paradise for pensioners and winter refugees. The island also attracts adventurers who want to explore breathtaking landscapes on winding roads on their motorcycles. M-Motorradreisen has now included the unique natural backdrop with the omnipresent, 3715m high Teide, lush forests and deep blue oceans in its program for the second time. This travel documentary shows the most beautiful tours on the two Canary Islands. (Station info).

programme.title: On Tour
programme.desc: Motorvision on Tour today in deepest Austria, at Lake Zenz. A particularly cool event takes place here: Snow & Ice Drifting and this is where our presenter will of course learn to drift today. programme.title: Classic
programme.desc: Classic cars and everything that goes with them: events, racing, portraits, mechanic tips and the most beautiful pictures from the automobile archives from all over the world. The most beautiful oldies, the hottest racing cars from bygone eras. (Station info).

programme.title: Green wave

(Station info).

programme.title: Made in....
programme.desc: We are in South Carolina in the Middle East of the USA. All BMW X3, X4, X5 and X6 models are built here. The largest BMW plant produces 32% of all BMW vehicles sold worldwide. And in the future, the new BMW X7 will also set new production records. Sherry McCraw is the vice president of the plant and employee number 38. She was there from the beginning and explains to us the milestones of the expansion of the SUV gigafactory into BMW's most important location. (Station info).

programme.title: 4x4 – Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: A mixture of sports car and off-road vehicle, coupe-like roof, only two individual seats at the back. programme.title: Top Speed Classic
programme.desc: Moderator Martin Utberg starts this episode in the Autostadt in Wolfsburg and gains insights into special company vehicles, including rare prototypes and extraordinary one-offs, in the Zeithaus and in the depot, which is not open to the public. He then travels to the Bremen Classic Motorshow, meets organizer Frank Ruge and talks to guests like Volker Strycek about the heydays of the DTM as well as those responsible for legendary projects like the Toyota 222D. An episode that shows how alive automotive history still is today. (Station info).

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Mercedes-Benz is the most successful automobile brand in motorsport. From the world's first car race in 1894 to today's Formula 1, Mercedes has been winning races all over the world for over 120 years. Whether Panamericana or Le Mans, DTM or Indianapolis, Silver Arrows or Formula 1, no other manufacturer has won as many races as Mercedes. The Mercedes racing drivers are always the greatest and most famous drivers of their time like Rudolf Carracciola, Juan Manuel Fangio or Lewis Hamilton. (Station info).
